
{{alias}}( e, y, p )
    Computes the squared epsilon insensitive loss.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    e: number
        Insensitivity parameter.

    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Squared epsilon insensitive loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 5.0, 10.2, 0.782 )
    ~19.519
    > v = {{alias}}( 2.0, 8.0, 0.202 )
    ~33.617
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 23.2, -0.999 )
    ~538.194
    > v = {{alias}}( 2.0, -21.0, 0.2 )
    368.64
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 1.0, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
